summary.text: Sam Rosemark is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 44 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican James Tacheny.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong district resident and member of the North St. Paul-Maplewood-Oakdale School Board.

paragraphs.text: Rosemark graduated from Tartan High School and from the University of Minnesota, Morris, in 2021, according to his Ballotpedia profile.
In the survey, he said he earned degrees in political science and economics and previously served as Director of Advocacy for the University of Minnesota Alumni Association.
He said he grew up in his mother's hair salon and his father's family bakery.
Rosemark listed lowering everyday costs, protecting reproductive freedom and LGBTQ+ rights, defending workers' rights and protecting clean air and water among his priorities.
He said he is especially passionate about public education, affordability, workers' rights, health care and the environment.
He won the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary.
